name: RADIANT INFRARED SAUNA
description: A Radiant Series Infrared Sauna allows you to relax in the ambiance of dry, long-wave warmth produced by extra-wide carbon fiber heating panels, similar to the warmth produced by the sun. Furthermore, an infrared sauna can be installed in any dry space, including carpeted bedrooms. Beautiful hemlock construction, soft lighting, Bluetooth audio, and a light therapy feature all combine to provide you with this infrared therapy series that’s exceptional in every way.
